about: Lakeside Village calls Snowfall and Sparkle a magical evening tradition that mixes falling snow, twinkling lights and a Christmas tree timed to holiday music. The shopping center is at 1479 Town Center Drive in Lakeland.
The snow is artificial, and the center notes that scheduled displays may be adjusted because of weather. Each flurry lasts roughly 15 minutes and begins on the hour, starting at 6 PM.
The center suggests making an evening of it with dinner at one of its restaurants or a stop in its shops for holiday gifts. A CMX Cinemas theater sits on the same property.
Lakeside Village runs several other free holiday events on The Lawn, including Santa Village market Saturdays on December 5 and 12 and a December 19 holiday concert with Santa storytime.
